title: THE SPIRIT IS BACK: EDMONTON ELKS WEST DIVISION CHAMPIONS
text:
THE SPIRIT IS BACK: EDMONTON ELKS WEST DIVISION CHAMPIONS

"For the first time since 2015, the Edmonton Elks have finished on top of the CFL West. They have brought belief back to our city, pride back to our fans, and reminded us what we can do together. The spirit is back. And the playoffs are calling!"

THE COACH'S BREAKDOWN:
Cultural turnarounds do not happen overnight. After years of heartbreak and rebuilding, this Edmonton team proved what happens when athletes commit to collective standards over individual ego. Finishing on top of the CFL West division for the first time in over a decade is not just a statistical milestone: it is a masterclass in athletic perseverance and civic revitalization.

LEADERSHIP & PERFORMANCE TAKEAWAY:
When belief returns to a locker room, momentum becomes undeniable. As coaches and leaders, our mission is to build systems of trust so strong that external doubt can never penetrate the huddle.

title: CLEVELAND: LOOK WHO IS ON TOP
slot: NFL Gameday Morning (Sun Oct 25, 10:00 AM MDT)
text:
CLEVELAND: LOOK WHO IS ON TOP

"4-2. First in the AFC North. Cleveland is on top after a dramatic 13-10 win over Baltimore. Four wins. Four fourth-quarter comebacks. This team is showing heart, resilience and a new identity."

THE COACH'S BREAKDOWN:
Four fourth-quarter comebacks in six weeks. That is not luck: that is psychological conditioning. In high-stakes competition, most teams fracture when trailing late. Cleveland is executing under fire because they have embraced adversity as their competitive advantage.

LEADERSHIP & PERFORMANCE TAKEAWAY:
Great teams do not panic when the clock winds down. They trust their preparation, regulate their emotions, and seize the defining possession. Poise in crunch time separates contenders from pretenders.

title: THE WEST GOES THROUGH EDMONTON: COUNTDOWN TO THE WESTERN FINAL
text:
THE WEST GOES THROUGH EDMONTON: COUNTDOWN TO THE WESTERN FINAL

"The Elks have earned the right to host the Western Final. Every practice has built this moment. Every decision has brought us here. Every player matters now. Can the Elks carry this momentum all the way to the Grey Cup?"

THE COACH'S BREAKDOWN:
Hosting the Western Final at Commonwealth Stadium on November 7 is the culmination of every grueling rep in training camp, every film study session, and every shared sacrifice. But playoff football is unforgiving: past wins guarantee nothing. The team that wins championship weekend is the team that stays present on every single down.

LEADERSHIP & PERFORMANCE TAKEAWAY:
Championship preparation is about eliminating distractions. When the stage gets bigger, your focus must get smaller. Master the immediate detail in front of you.

title: GAMEDAY AT COMMONWEALTH: THE ROAD TO THE GREY CUP
slot: Western Final Gameday (Sat Nov 07, 10:00 AM MST)
text:
GAMEDAY AT COMMONWEALTH: THE ROAD TO THE GREY CUP

"Today, the West goes through Edmonton. Sixty minutes of championship football between Commonwealth Stadium and the Grey Cup. Play with heart. Trust your brothers. Leave everything on the turf."

THE COACH'S BREAKDOWN:
This is what every athlete dreams of: sixty minutes for the right to play for the ultimate prize. In championship moments, you do not rise to the occasion: you sink to the level of your training. Edmonton has built the foundation. Now is the time to trust the work, embrace the physical battle, and finish strong.

LEADERSHIP & PERFORMANCE TAKEAWAY:
When pressure reaches its peak, true competitors do not flinch. Stand tall, play for the city, and let your preparation speak.
